h1: Offer messages shared at the right moment
overview: A good offer works best when it appears at the right time and says the terms clearly. We set up rules for when your assistant shares an offer, such as a first order discount, a free shipping threshold or a sale on a collection a shopper is browsing. We write the wording, set limits on how often it appears and connect real discount codes from your store. Every offer shows its end date and conditions, and we test it from first message to checkout.

faq: Yes. We show the real discount, the end date and the conditions. We do not use fake countdowns, invented scarcity or prices that were never charged. This also keeps you within consumer rules.
Can the assistant create its own discounts?
No. It shares offers you set up, with codes created in your store. This keeps your margins safe and your offers consistent. Changes happen when you edit the rule.
How often will shoppers see an offer?
Rarely, by design. We set limits such as once per visit and not again for a few days, so it feels like help and not a pop up that follows people around.
Which stores does this work with?
Any store where we can add a chat widget and create discount codes, including Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and Wix. We confirm your setup before we begin.
